_note: Demo-only fake attendee dataset. The flow demo (tests/flow-demo.spec.ts) injects it through the existing RSVP API to stand in for collected survey responses, bypassing the survey UI as if the results were hand-loaded into the backend. printed_name fills the Name for printing text question; size fills the Size choice the organizer requests from the shirt's variants. No app module reads this file, and nothing in the real wiring branches on it.
